scenario.description: Phase 2: one Yellow (damage 2: poison 2.8) upstream on Lyne and three damage-3 Blues downstream, sandbox cash, waves 1-9 sent 2 s apart so creeps (up to 106 HP) survive sparks. Freezes charge accumulation (10/s to 120), charged shots (poison + 3 x charge/100, 50 charge each), spark hits (slow subtracted before damage, floor 5), fast-mode targeting with lock off, leg re-planning on every slow and the +2 px/s per 1000 ms recovery.
